name: De Kromme Dissel
dinnerNote: Kromme Dissel menu, 6 courses (4 courses €120, 5 courses €135)
lunchNote: Kromme Dissel menu, 4 courses · Fri–Sat (6 courses €150)

menus.name: Kromme Dissel menu
menus.note: Lunch or dinner. Also as 4 courses (€120, pairing €52) or 5 courses (€135, pairing €65); 7-glass pairing €91. Sweetbread dish and Kim's cheese trolley €25 extra each.

menus.name: 55th anniversary Signature Classics menu
menus.note: Classic signature dishes with anniversary amuse-bouches, until 30 January 2027. Book at least 24 hours ahead.

bookingOpens: Online through the restaurant's booking page (TheFork), or by phone. Lunch Friday and Saturday from 12pm; dinner Tuesday to Saturday from 6pm; closed Sunday and Monday.

stay.name: Fletcher Boutique Hotel De Kromme Dissel

packages.name: De Kromme Dissel Diner Arrangement
packages.includes: A night in a Kromme Dissel room, a 5-course dinner at the starred restaurant, breakfast and a goodie bag; content differs between weekend and midweek

packages.name: De Kromme Dissel Lunch Arrangement
packages.includes: Early check-in, a night in a Kromme Dissel room, a 4-course lunch at the starred restaurant on arrival day, breakfast, host and turndown service

packages.name: Jubileum Arrangement (55 years of a Michelin star)
packages.includes: A night in a Kromme Dissel room, the 5-course Signature Classics anniversary menu with amuses, breakfast and a goodie bag
packages.when: Midweek (Tuesday to Thursday) and weekend (Friday and Saturday) versions

stay.note: A boutique hotel next door to the restaurant with 18 rooms, a pool and a sauna; the weekend breakfast is served in the restaurant.
